name: Mexican Taco Beef Pasta Bake

components.name: Taco Beef Pasta Bake

ingredients.name: Italian canned crushed tomatoes with herbs
Water to help uncooked pasta soften in the oven

steps: Preheat oven to 180 C and prepare a deep baking dish large enough for pasta to sit below the liquid level.
Combine raw lean beef mince with chopped peppers, onion, crushed tomatoes, taco seasoning, light cream cheese, mozzarella and uncooked bowtie pasta; use a sturdy spoon to separate the mince evenly.
Add 100 ml water if the mixture seems dry, particularly if the canned tomato has little juice. Stir so pasta is largely coated and can hydrate evenly.
Cover dish very tightly with foil to trap steam and bake about 45 minutes.
Remove foil, stir carefully and check pasta tenderness and beef doneness, cooking longer if necessary until every section reaches 71 C. Bake uncovered another 5 minutes to brown the top.
Rest 5 minutes, then split into four large portions. Cool rapidly, refrigerate or freeze soon after cooking.

Planning: PRIMARY OVEN with no pre-cooked meat or pasta; ensure deep covered baking dish and meat temperature.
Freezer: freezer-friendly, but dairy texture and pasta firmness may change
Dietary: Contains dairy, wheat; taco mix allergen ingredients depend on brand.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
